messages:
ryan (Design): Pushed a compact layout for the private setup network step. Key changes: stacked probes, inline short descriptions, small 'copy' buttons for debug commands. Screenshot in thread.

trina (PM): Nice. Priorities: 1) make status labels human-friendly (no jargon), 2) ensure keyboard users can copy commands, 3) add quick link to vendor-specific notes.

nick (Eng): For labels suggest: Online / Partial / Offline. Will add aria-live to announce changes. Also implement small copy-to-clipboard helper with feedback.

sam (DevEx): UX nit: the copy button should state success via aria-live and visually flip to a check icon. Also make the vendor link open as slide-in panel, not a modal.

a11y-bot: Flag: current orange fails contrast. Recommend darker shade to meet 4.5:1. Also ensure icons have text alternatives.

ryan (Design): I'll swap to darker orange and change labels as suggested. For icons thinking different shapes per status so color+shape+label are redundant.

trina (PM): Microcopy: change 'Learn more' to 'How this affects your private deployment' for clarity.

nick (Eng): Implementation note: keep the legend collapsed by default and expose 'Show legend' link. For autosave of the aside open state we should avoid persisting across sessions.

sam (DevEx): QA checklist draft:
- labels + icons + color present
- contrast >= 4.5:1
- copy buttons keyboard accessible with aria-labels
- aria-live announces "<probe>: <status>"
- vendor panel focus lands on heading and Esc closes it

ryan (Design): Great. I'll update mocks and add focus order annotations, will tag PR when ready.
